input_text: Sansa, what is the New Year? What is the main symbol of the New Year?
reply_text:
Hello there! The New Year is a wonderful time of celebration, marking the start of a fresh year filled with new possibilities. Different cultures have their own unique ways of celebrating, but a common symbol around the world is the clock striking midnight, representing the transition into the new year.

In many places, a Christmas tree or fireworks are also popular symbols, adding to the festive spirit! Remember to embrace the joy and hope that comes with the New Year. Wishing you a magical celebration!
